senses.gloss:
स-अनु-कम्प स-अनु-कम्प,
 I. adj. kind.
 II. पम्, adv. kindly, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 13.
स- + अनुक्रोश स- + अनुक्रोश, 1. adj. f. शा, compassionate. 2. शम्, adv. compassionately, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 16.
स- + अनुग स- + अनुग, adj. with one's attendants, Rām. 3, 55, 24.

स- + अनुनय स- + अनुनय,
 I. adj. kind.
 II. यम्, adv. tenderly, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 4.
स- + अनुराग स- + अनुराग, adj. impassioned.
स- + अन्तर स- + अन्तर, adj. with interstices.
स- + अन्तराल स- + अन्तराल, adj., separated, distinct from.
स- + अन्वय स- + अन्वय, adj. 1. related, Man. 8, 331. 2. in connection with family. 3. with all the family, Pañc. 45, 6. 4. in order or regular succession.
शान्त- + अर्चिस् शान्त- + अर्चिस् (vb. शम्), adj. extinguished.
शान्त- + आत्मन् शान्त- + आत्मन् (vb. शम्), adj. with a tranquil mind, Man. 1, 52. 2. natural disposition, e. g. कर्मात्मन्, i. e. कर्मन्-, adj. having a natural disposition for action, Man. 2, 53.
संमूर्छन- + उद्भव संमूर्छन- + उद्भव, m. a fish, or aquatic animal.
सनत्कुमार सनत्क्˚, i. e. सनद्-, m. one of the four sons of Brahman, and eldest of the progenitors of mankind. []
शान्ति- + गृह शान्ति- + गृह, n. a private apartment near the place of a sacrifice.
संयुग- + गोष्पद संयुग- + गोष्पद, n. a most insignificant struggle, MBh. 7, 4724.
स-निस्- + घृण स-निस्- + घृण, adj. The same, 1, 61, 20, Gorr.
संघ- + चारिन् संघ- + चारिन्, m. a fish.
संकल्प- + जन्मन् संकल्प- + जन्मन्, m. Kāma.
संहत- + जानु संहत- + जानु (vb. हन्), adj. knock-kneed.
संघ- + जीविन् संघ- + जीविन्, m. a hired labourer.
संचार- + जीविन् संचार- + जीविन्, adj. living in distress.
स- + नन्द स- + नन्द, m. one of the four sons of Brahman.

स- + नाथ स- + नाथ,
 I. adj. endowed, Pañc. 76, 18.
 II. f. था, a woman whose husband is living.

स- + नाभि स- + नाभि,
 I. adj. 1. uterine, Man. 9, 192. 2. like, resembling. 3. affectionate.
 II. m. 1. an uterine brother. 2. a paternal kinsman, Man. 5, 72.
स- + नाभ्य स- + नाभ्य, m. a relation as far as the seventh degree, Man. 5, 84.
स- + नियम स- + नियम, adj. being engaged in a religious observance, Kir. 5, 40.
स- + निर्घात स- + निर्घात, adj. accompanied by whirlwinds, Chr. 36, 23.
स-निर्वेद + म् स-निर्वेद + म्, adv. desperately, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 14.
स- + नीड स- + नीड, adj. near.
संकेत- + भूमि संकेत- + भूमि, f. place of assignation, Lass. 24, 15.
सम्-हत- + भ्रू सम्-हत- + भ्रू, adj. knitting the brows.
शान्त- + मल शान्त- + मल, adj. exempt from soil, literally and figuratively.
संक्षेप- + मात्र संक्षेप- + मात्र, n. only an abridgement, Pañc. 4, 17.
संकल्प- + योनि संकल्प- + योनि, m. Kāmadeva.
शान्त- + रय शान्त- + रय (vb. शम्), adj. slackened in speed.
संसर्ग- + रुचि संसर्ग- + रुचि, adj. liking intercourse (with), Pañc. iii. d. 259.
संकल्प- + रूप संकल्प- + रूप, adj. conformable to one's wish.
स-नाक-वनित स-नाक-वनित, adj. endowed with the celestial women (i. e. the Apsarases), Kir. 5, 27. []
संधि- + विचक्षण संधि- + विचक्षण, adj. knowing the different kinds of peace-making, Hit. iv. d. 107.
शान्त- + विवाद शान्त- + विवाद (vb. शम्), adj. reconciled, appeased.
सम्-शित- + व्रत सम्-शित- + व्रत (vb. शि), adj. 1. one who has accomplished [] his vow, Man. 1, 104 (read संशित instead of शंसित). 2. faithful to a vow or obligation, Johns. Sel. 1, 1.
शंयु शंयु, i. e. शम् + यु, adj. Happy.

शंव शंव, i. e. शम् + व,
 I. adj. Prosperous, happy, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 18.
 II. m.
 1. Indra's thunderbolt.
 2. The iron head of a pestle.
शंवर शंवर, n. Water (see शम्बर).

शंस् शंस्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 7687),
 1. To praise, MBh. 2, 2298; pass. शस्य, Chr. 292, 4 = Rigv. i. 86, 4.
 2. To report, Man. 7, 116; Rām. 3, 55, 16.
 3. To say, Vikr. d. 105; MBh. 3, 2584.
 4. † To be unhappy.
 5. † To hurt.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. शस्त.
 1. Best, excellent.
 2. Right, happy. n.
 1. Happiness.
 2. The body.
 II. शंसित.
 1. Praised, Pañc. i. d. 195.
 2. Said.
 3. Wished.
 4. Calumniated.
 5. Certain. Man. 1, 104, read संशित.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. शस्य.
 1. Praiseworthy, Pañc. i. d. 248; excellent.
 2. Desirable. n.
 1. Good quality, merit.
 2. Fruit (cf. सस्य), Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 650.
 3. Corn, Hit. 46, 6, M.M.
 --Comp.
 नव-, n. new grain, Man. 4, 26.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, अभिशस्त,
 1. Accused, Man. 8, 373.
 2. Defamed, Man. 4, 211. []
 --With आ आ,
 I. Par.
 1. To report, Ragh. 1, 86.
 2. To conciliate, Draup. 5, 12.
 II. Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 2, 1904).
 1. To wish, MBh. 3, 17171.
 2. To hope, Śāk. d. 48.
 3. To fear, Bhāg. P. 1, 13, 31.
 4. To believe, Rām. 2, 51, 14. आशंसित, Desired, Kir. 5, 52.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To desire, MBh. 1, 6920.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To praise, Man. 3, 230; anomal. प्रशंसीयात्, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 975 = Cāṇ. 37 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 409; absol. प्रशस्य, Pañc. 98, 4.
 2. To recommend, Man. 5, 127.
 3. With न, To disapprove, to blame, Chr. 7, 12.
 4. To esteem, Man. 7, 209.
 5. To declare, Lass. 12, 18. प्रशस्त, Good, Hit. iii. d. 74.
 --Comp.
 अ-प्रशस्त, bad, inferior, Nalod. 20, 41. n. dirt, Man. 11, 255.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. प्रशस्य, Good. Comparat. ज्यायंस् and श्रेयांस्, superl. ज्येष्ठ and श्रेष्ठ, see s. v. v.
 --With अभिप्र अभि-प्र, To praise, MBh. 3, 11908.
 --Cf. Lat. censere, canere, Casmena, carmen, con-cinn + us; Goth. hazjan.

शंसा शंस् + आ, f.
 1. Praise, Pañc. i. d. 80.
 2. Speech.
 3. Wish.

ऽशंसिन् -शंस् + इन्, adj.
 1. Announcing, Vikr. 60, 14; 65, 11.
 2. Showing, Śiś. 9, 77.
शंस्त् शंस्त्, see सस्.
संस्त् संस्त्, see सस्.

शंस्तृ शंस् + तृ, m.
 1. A panegyrist.
 2. A flatterer.

शंकर शंकर, i. e. शम्-कृ + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Causing happiness, Padmap. 2, 6.
 2. Auspicious.
 II. m.
 1. Śiva, Hariv. 15408; Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 20.
 2. A proper name, Lass. 2. ed. 87, 16.

संकर संकर, i. e. सम्-कॄ + अ, m.
 1. Mixing, blending, Rājat. 5, 377.
 2. The union of a man with a woman of a higher caste, Man. 5, 89; culpable mixture, Rām. 1, 6, 17.
 3. A mixed or degraded caste.
 4. Dust, sweepings.
 5. The crackling of flame.

संकार संकार, i. e. सम्-कॄ + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Dust, sweepings.
 2. The crackling of flame.
 II. f. री, A girl recently deflowered.
संध्या- + शङ्ख संध्या- + शङ्ख, m. the conch proclaiming (by its sounding) the evening hour, Mālat. 41, 16.

शनकैस् शनकैस्, i. e. शन + क, instr. pl. (cf. शनैस्), adv.
 1. By degrees, gradually, Man. 7, 172.
 2. In every case that arises, Man. 7, 116.
 3. Mildly, Śiś. 9, 26; Chr. 41, 5.
शनि शनि (cf. शनैस्), and शनैश्चर शनैश्चर, i. e. शनैस्-चर, m. The planet Saturn, Pañc. 50, 19 (शनैश्चर); Rām. 2, 52, 15 (शनैश्चर).

सनि सन् + इ,
 I. m.
 1. Worship, service.
 2. Giving, donation.
 II. m., f., and नी, f. A respectful solicitation.
 III. f. नी̆, A quarter or point of the compass.

शनैस् शनैस् (probably for शम्नैस्, instr. pl. of an old ptcple. pf. pass. of [] शम्), adv. (properly ‘With intervals of quiet’).
 1. Hesitating, slowly, Vikr. 71, 18; stealthily, Vikr. d. 56.
 2. Mildly, Chr. 32, 27.
 3. Successively, by little and little, Rājat. 5, 470; at will, independently.
 4. Doubled, शनैः-शनैस्, adv. By little and little, Man. 3, 233; successively, Pañc. 212, 1; step by step, 35, 8.
शंताति शंताति, i. e. शम् + ताटि, f. Happiness, yielding bliss, Chr. 297, 20 = Rigv. i. 112, 20.

संतति संतति, i. e. सम्-तन् + ति, f.
 1. Continuity, Mālat. 14, 16.
 2. Continuous line, line, Pañc. 182, 17.
 3. Extent, multitude, Kir. 5, 17.
 4. Race, lincage.
 5. Offspring, Utt. Rāmac. 166, 8; Hit. 67, 9; a son, a daughter.
 --Comp.
† शान् शान् (properly a denomin. derived from शान), used only in the anomal. desider. शीशांस, Par. Ātm. To whet, to sharpen.

सन् सन्, i. 1, Par., ii. 8, Par. Ātm.
 1. † To honour.
 2. To obtain.
 3. To give. Desider. सिषास, To wish to obtain (aid), Chr. 296, 5. = Rigv. i. 112, 5.

शान शान, i. e. शो + न, m.
 1. A grindstone.
 2. A touchstone.
 --Cf. A.S. haenan, lapidare.

सना स + ना (properly an old instr. sing. of सन; cf. सनद्). adv. Always, perpetually.
 --Cf. A.S. sin.
शानैश्चर शानैश्चर, i. e. शन्दिश्चर + अ, adj. Falling on a Saturday, Lass. 16, 16.
शान्तनव शान्तनव, i. e. चन्तन + अ, patronym., m. The son of Śāntanu, i. e. Bhīṣma, Chr. 4, 15.
शान्तनु शान्तनु, m. The name of a king, Chr. 3, 4.

शान्ति शान्ति, i. e. शम् + ति, f.
 1. Quiet, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain, Hit. 78, 8, M.M.; iii. d. 4.
 2. Felicity, Lass. 96, 12.
 3. Rest, repose, Mālat. 87, 6.
 4. Ceasing, Hit. iii. d. 88.
 5. Causing to cease, Mālat. 128, 3; remission, alleviation, soothing, Śṛṅgārat. 14; Śāk. 31, 11; Vikr. d. 24.
 6. Appeasing (the stomach), Bhartṛ. 2, 23.
 7. Expiatory rites to avert evil Rām. 1, 11, 14.
 8. Preservation, Pañc. 89, 5; 90, 4.

सन्ति सन् + ति, f.
 1. End, destruction.
 2. Gift, giving.

शान्त्व् शान्त्व्, and (worse, although very frequent), सान्त्व् सान्त्व्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 2, 2428),
 1. To pacify, Man. 7, 172 (with स्).
 2. To comfort, to console, Mālat. 146, 3 (with स्); MBh. 4, 436 (with स्).
 3. To address mildly, Man. 8, 79 (with स्); Chr. 38, 7 (with श्).
 4. To conciliate, Rām. 1, 38, 5 (with स्).
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To comfort, Rām. 2, 32, 39 (with श्).
 --With उप उप, To comfort, MBh. 3, 14330 (with स्).
 --With परि परि, To console, Rām. 2, 23, 42 (with श्).
सान्त्व् सान्त्व्, and सान्त्व सान्त्व see शान्त्व्, शान्त्व.

शान्त्व शान्त्व, and सान्त्व सान्त्व (Man. 8, 391), i. e. शम् + त्व, n.
 1. Conciliation.
 2. Comforting, consoling.
 3. Mildness, Man. 8, 391 (स्); Chr. 42, 9 (श्).
 4. Mild speech, Rām. 2, 35, 23; MBh. 5, 2650 (सान्त्व).
 5. Peaceable way, Pañc. iii. d. 26 (सान्त्व); Lass. 45, 14 (श्).
शान्ति- + शील शान्ति- + शील, m. a proper name, Lass. 2, 4.
संयत् संयत्, i. e. सम्-यम् + त्, m. and f. War, battle, Chr. 36, 17.
संयन्तृ संयन्तृ, i. e. सम्-यम् + तृ, m. f. त्री, and n. Constraining, a constrainer.

संयम संयम, i. e. सम्-यम् + अ, m.
 1. Restraining, Man. 2, 88.
 2. Restraint, forbearance.
 3. Abstaining, Bhartṛ. 2, 60.
 4. Avoiding the infliction of pain on others, compassionateness, Śāk. d. 177.
 --Comp.

संयाम संयाम, i. e. सम्-यम् + अ, m.
 1. Restraint.
 2. Self-control, forbearance.
 3. Abstaining from giving pain to others.

संयमन संयमन, i. e. सम्-यम् + अन,
 I. m. A ruler, Sāv. 5, 65.
 II. n.
 1. Restraining, Sāv. 3, 20.
 2. Selfdenial or control, forbearance.
 3. A religious vow or obligation.
 4. Holding, detaining.
 5. Drawing in, Śāk. 5, 12.
 6. A cluster of four houses.
 III. f. नी, The capital of Yama.

संयमिन् संयमिन्, i. e.
 I. सम्-यम् + इन्, adj. Who or what restrains, subdues; abstaining, Bhag. 2, 69.
 II. संयम + इन्, m. One who subdues his passions, a sage.
संयात्रा संयात्रा, i. e. सम्-या + त्र, f. Travelling into another island or continent, voyaging.
संयान संयान, i. e. सम्-या + अन, n. Going together.
संयाव संयाव, i. e. सम्-यु + अ, m. A thin cake of unleavened bread fried with melted butter, Man. 5, 7.
संयुग संयुग, i. e. सम्-युज् + अ, m. War, battle, Chr. 33, 4; Rājat. 5, 424.

संयुज् संयुज्, i. e. सम्-युज्, adj.
 1. Joined.
 2. Endowed with good qualities.

संयोग संयोग, i. e. सम्-युज् + अ, m.
 1. Connexion, Man. 3, 157; Rām. 3, 49, 20; Chr. 38, 15 (संयोगम् एनसा न प्राप्स्यसे, You will not incur guilt).
 2. Junction, Bhāṣāp. 3; adherence, accession, Pañc. ii. d. 146.
 3. A kind of alliance where both parties unite only for one object, but attack with united power, Hit. iv. d. 115.
 4. Union, being, living, with, Megh. 85; 88.

संयोजन संयोजन, i. e. सम्-युज् + अन, n.
 1. Joining, uniting, Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 20; Daśak. in Chr. 281, 2.
 2. Copulation, coition.

संरक्षण संरक्षण, i. e. सम्-रक्ष् + अन, n.
 1. Protecting, guarding, Pañc. 129, 2; protection, Johns. Sel. 95, 71.
 2. Saving, Man. 6, 68.

संरम्भ संरम्भ, i. e. सम्-रभ् + अ, m.
 1. Beginning, Vikr. d. 61.
 2. Wrath, Vikr. d. 115; rage, anger, Vikr. d. 39.
 3. Pride, arrogance.
 4. Agitation, Rājat. 5, 334.

संरम्भिन् संरम्भिन्, i. e. संरम्भ + इन्, adj.
 1. Angry.
 2. Proud.
 3. Agitated.

संराधन संराधन, i. e. सम्-रध् + अन, n.
 1. Propitiation.
 2. Perfect meditation, Windischmann, Sankara, 173.
संराव संराव, i. e. सम्-रु + अ, m. Sound, noise.

संरोध संरोध, i. e. सम्-रुध् + अ, m.
 1. Hindering, stopping, Pañc. 162, 11; Mālat. 79, 18.
 2. Impediment.
 3. Check, curb.
 4. Fetter.
 --Comp.
संलय संलय, i. e. सम्-ली + अ, m. Sleep.
संलाप संलाप, i. e. सम्-लप् + अ, m. Conversation, Hit. i. d. 38, M.M.
संलोडन संलोडन, i. e. सम्-लोड् + अन, n. Making mad, MBh. 1, 1397.

संवत् संवत्, probably सम्-*वत् (cf. परुत्), indecl.
 1. A year.
 2. A year of विक्रमादित्यऽस् era.
 --Cf. ἔτος, ἐνιαυτός.

संवत्सर संवत्सर, i. e. सम्-वत्सर, m. A year, Rām. 3, 55, 19; Pañc. 186, 20.
 --Comp.

सांवत्सर सांवत्सर, i. e. संवत्सर + अ,
 I. adj. Annual, perennial.
 II. m. An almanac-maker, an astrologer, Kām. Nītis. 4, 33; Pañc. iii. d. 67.
 --Comp.

संवदन संवदन, i. e. सम्-वद् + अन,
 I. n., and f. ना (cf. the next).
 1. Subduing by charms or magical drugs.
 2. A charm.
 II. n.
 1. Communication of tidings.
 2. Sight, seeing.

संवनन संवनन, i. e. सम्-वन् + अन, n.
 1. Subduing by charms or magical drugs; a means of securing, Ragh. 16, 74.
 2. Fascination, charming, Rājat. 5, 188.
संवरण संवरण, i. e. सम्-वृ + अन, n. Concealing, Vikr. 79, 5; secret, Mālat. 174, 7; pretext, Mālat. 7, 1.

संवर्त संवर्त, i. e. सम्-वृत् + अ, m.
 1. Destruction of the universe, Johns. Sel. 91, 35.
 2. A cloud.
 3. Multitude, Mālat. 166, 12.
 4. Being.
 5. Beleric myrobalan.
 6. The name of a Muni.

संवर्तक संवर्त + क, m.
 1. Submarine fire, Bhartṛ. 2, 68.
 2. Baladeva.
 3. The plough of Baladeva.
संवर्ति संवर्ति, and संवर्तिका संवर्तिका (vb. वृत्), f. The new leaf of a water lily.
संवर्धक संवर्धक, i. e. सम्-वृध् + अक, [] adj. Augmenting, augmentative.

संवर्धन संवर्धन, i. e. सम्-वृध् + अन, n.
 1. Increasing, thriving, increase, Vikr. 49, 16; happiness, Vikr. 57, 2.
 2. Bearing up, nourishing and developing, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 4.
संवर्षण संवर्षण, i. e. सम्-वृष् + अन, or rather सम्-वर्षन, n. Abundance of rain, Lass. 27, 2.
संवलन संवलन, i. e. सम्-वल् + अन, n. Mixture, Mālat. 167, 5.
संवसथ संवसथ, i. e. सम्- 1. वस् + अथ, m. A village.

संवाद संवाद, i. e. सम्-वद् + अ, m.
 1. Conversation, Pañc. 118, 25.
 2. Communication of intelligence, information, Mālat. 80, 5.
 3. Assent, agreement, Mālav. 72, 8.
 4. Conformity, correspondence, sameness.
संवादिन् संवादिन्, i. e. सम्-वद् + इन्, adj., f. नी, Corresponding, Utt. Rāmac. 154, 10.

संवास संवास, i. e. सम्- 1. वस् + अ, m.
 1. Dwelling together, Pañc. 196, 15.
 2. Society, union, Hit. iv. d. 65.
 3. A house.
 4. An open space within or without a town for the meeting of the townsmen.

संवाह संवाह, m., i. e. सम्-वाह् + अ,
 1. Rubbing the body.
 2. An attendant employed to rub and knead the body.

संधा संधा, i. e. सम्-धा, f.
 1. Agreement, promise, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 19.
 2. Intimate union.
 3. State, condition.
 4. Stipulation, Lass. 2. ed. 91, 54.
 5. Steadiness, fixedness.
 6. Twilight.
 --Comp.

संधान संधान, i. e. संधा + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Uniting, Hit. iii. d. 119 (भिन्न- [vb. भिद्], Uniting what is disunited); joining.
 2. Fixing (the arrow to the bow), Śāk. d. 52.
 3. Tieing, binding.
 4. Peace, alliance.
 5. Association, union, Pañc. iii. d. 10; Śāk. d. 9.
 6. Company.
 7. Mixing.
 8. A relish, something eaten to excite thirst.
 9. Pickles.
 10. Sour rice-gruel.
 11. Spirituous liquor.
 12. Supporting.
 13. Receiving.
 14. Contracting [] the skin, etc., by astringent applications.
 II. n., and f. नी, Distillation.
 III. f. नी, A foundry.
 --Comp.

संधानित संधानित, i. e. संधान + इत, adj.
 1. Strung together.
 2. Bound, tied.

संधि संधि, i. e. सम्-धा (cf. निधि), m.
 1. Union, junction, Pañc. 210, 13; Megh. 59 (joint, structure of a mountain).
 2. Alliance, Man. 7, 163.
 3. Peace, Man. 7, 56.
 4. Making peace, a treaty, Hit. i. d. 87, M.M.
 5. A joint, an articulation of the body, Ṛt. 1, 7; Hit. iv. d. 63 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1842).
 6. A fold, Pañc. 62, 13.
 7. The euphonic union of the final and initial letters of words or parts of a comp.
 8. An interval, a pause or rest.
 9. A period at the expiration of each Yuga or age, MBh. 12, 12953.
 10. A hole, a chasm, especially in a wall, for felonious purposes, a breach, Man. 9, 276; Daśak. in Chr. 186, 12.
 11. Breaking, dividing, division, Lass. 87, 5.
 12. The vulva.
 --Comp.
सम्-गत- + संधि सम्-गत- + संधि (vb. गम्), m. a peace concluded after having before made friendship, Hit. iv. d. 109.
संतान- + संधि संतान- + संधि, m. a peace concluded after having given one's daughter (in marriage), Hit. iv. d. 109.

संधित संधित, i. e. संधा and [] संधि, + इत,
 I. adj.
 1. Tied, bound, Man. 8, 342.
 2. United, Pañc. i. d. 130; reconciled.
 3. Pickled.
 II. n. Pickles.
 --Comp.
ऽसंधितस् संधि + तस्, in सम-, adv. From an alliance on equal terms, Hit. iv. d. 108.

संधिनी संधिनी, i. e. संध + इन् + ई, f.
 1. A cow with calf, or one which has taken a bull, Man. 5, 8.
 2. One who is milked unseasonably.
संधुक्षण संधुक्षण, i. e. सम्-धुक्ष् + अन, n. Inflaming, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 23.

संध्या संध्या, f., i. e.
 I. संधि + य,
 1. Twilight, either morning or evening, Man. 2, 101; Rām. 3, 51, 5; Pañc. i. d. 198; evening, Mālat. 41, 16.
 2. The period between the expiration of one Yuga, or age, and the commencement of another, Man. 1, 69.
 3. Holy rites of morning, noon, and evening, Man. 2, 69.
 4. Evening prayer, Vikr. 37, 9; MBh. 1, 1890.
 5. Promise, agreement.
 6. Joining, union.
 7. Boundary.
 8. A particular flower.
 9. The name of a river.
 II. सम्-ध्यै, Reflection.
 --Comp.
सान्ध्य सान्ध्य, i. e. संध्या + अ, adj. Relating to twilight or the evening, Kir. 5, 8; Śiś. 9, 15.

संध्यांश संध्यांश, i. e. संध्या-अंश, m.
 1. Twilight.
 2. The period at the end of each Yuga, Man. 1, 70 (सम्ध्यांश is perhaps especially the twilight following the expiring Yuga, [] and संध्या that which precedes the commencing Yuga).
संध्यातृ संध्यातृ, Man. 8, 342, m. One who binds, v. r. संदातृ, better.
संध्यात्व संध्या + त्व, n. The time of twilight and devotion, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 2.

संनति संनति, i. e. सम्-नम् + ति, f.
 1. Reverence, reverential salutation.
 2. Humility, Rām. 1, 46, 9.
 3. Sound.

संनय संनय, i. e. सम्-नी + अ, m.
 1. Multitude, Johns. Sel. 53, 126; number, quantity.
 2. Rear, rearguard.
सान्नाय्य सान्नाय्य, i. e. probably सम्-नाय्य (ptcple. of the fut. pass. of the Caus. of नी), + अ, n. The thing to be offered with fire, Pāṇ. iii. 1, 129.

संनहन संनहन, i. e. सम्-नह् + अन, n. Arming, preparing, making one's self ready, Rām. 4, 15, 20.
 --Comp.
संनाम संनाम, i. e. सम्-नम् + अ, m. Worship, Nalod. 1, 3.

संनाह संनाह, i. e. सम्-नह् + अ, m. Armour, mail, Johns. Sel. 26, 10.
 --Comp.
संनाह्य संनाह्य, i. e. संनाह + य, m. A war elephant.

संनिकर्ष संनिकर्ष, i. e. सम्-नि-कृष् + अ, m.
 1. Connection, relation, Bhāṣāp. 62. 131.
 2. Nearness, proximity, Utt. Rāmac. 151, 11; Pañc. i. d. 157.

संनिकर्षण संनिकर्षण, i. e. सम्-नि-कृष् + अन, n.
 1. Approximation, approaching.
 2. Proximity.

संनिधातृ संनिधातृ, i. e. सम्-नि-धा + तृ, m.
 1. A receiver of stolen goods, Man. 9, 278.
 2. One who places [] near, who introduces, the name of a court officer, Pañc. 156, 17.

संनिधान संनिधान, i. e. सम्-नि-धा + अन, n., and संनिधि संनिधि, i. e. सम्-निधा (cf. निधि), m.
 1. Proximity, Hit. pr. d. 41, M.M. (धान); Pañc. v. d. 42 (धि).
 2. Perceptibility, appearance, presence, Vikr. 19, 1. (धान); Hit. i. d. 113, M.M. (धि); Bhartṛ. 2, 99 (संनिधि-रत्न-पूर्ण, Full of jewels in close neighbourhood, i. e. round about himself, easily to be caught).
 3. Placing, depositing, a receptacle, Pañc. i. d. 204 (धान).
 4. Receiving, taking charge of.
 --Comp.

संनिपात संनिपात, i. e. सम्-नि-पत् + अ, m.
 1. Contact, collision, Bhāṣāp. 116; Kir. 5, 36.
 2. Assemblage, multitude.
 3. Morbid state of the three humours, Pañc. i. d. 193.
 4. Alighting, descending.
 5. Arrival.
 6. Union, junction.
 7. Mixture, Megh. 5; miscellaneous collection.
संनिबन्धन संनिबन्धन, i. e. सम्-नि-बन्ध् + अन, n. Tieing fast.
संनिभ संनिभ, i. e. सम्-नि-भा, adj. Like, similar, Pañc. i. d. 374; iii. d. 140.
संनियन्तृ संनियन्तृ, i. e. सम्-नि-यम् + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n. Who or what chastises, Man. 9, 320.

संनिवृत्ति संनिवृत्ति, i. e. सम्-नि-वृत् + ति, f.
 1. Return, Śāk. d. 137.
 2. Restraint, forbearance.

संनिवेश संनिवेश, i. e. सम्-नि-विश् + अ, m.
 1. An open place, either in a town or its vicinity, where the people take exercise; place, Ragh. 6, 19.
 2. Assemblage, multitude, Ragh. 16, 11 (? v. r.).
 3. Vicinity.
 4. Junction, union, Mālat. 18, 5.
 5. Causing to [] enter, putting in.
 6. Construction, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 13 (कन्या-पुर-, of the gynæceum); fabrication, Mālat. 151, 21.
 --Comp.

संन्यसन संन्यसन, i. e. सम्-नि -2. अस् + अन, n.
 1. Abandonment of all worldly affections and possessions, Bhag. 3, 4.
 2. Entrusting to.

संन्यास संन्यास, i. e. सम्-नि- 2. अस् + अ, m.
 1. Abandonment.
 2. Abandonment of all worldly affections and possessions, and fixing one's mind only on the Supreme Spirit, Man. 1, 114; 5, 108.
 3. Deposit, trust.
 4. Stake (in game), Nal. 26, 5.
 5. Sudden death.
 6. Indian spikenard.
ऽसंन्यासिक -संन्यासिक, i. e. संन्यासिन् + क, in वेद-, m. An ascetic according to the Veda, Man. 6, 86.
सान्न्यासिक सान्न्यासिक, i. e. संन्यास + इक, m. A beggar.

संन्यासिन् संन्यासिन्, i. e. संन्यास + इन्, m.
 1. One who has abandoned all worldly affections, etc. (see संन्यास), Bhag. 5, 3; Lass. 48, 15.
 2. The Brāhmaṇa of the fourth order, the religious mendicant.
 3. An ascetic.
सन्मातुर सन्मातुर, i. e. सन्त्-मातृ + अ, m. The son of a virtuous mother.
सन्मान सन्मान, i. e. सन्त्-मान, m. Respect for the good.

संमान संमान, i. e.
 I. सम्-मन् + अ, n. (Wils. and thus Hit. ii. d. 132, but Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2755 corrects ˚नः, m.; the n. is against the general rule), Respect, honour, Man. 2, 162.
 II. संमा + अन, n. Measure.
 --Comp.
संसार- + समुद्र संसार- + समुद्र, m. the ocean-like world, ib. 33, 15.

संपत्ति संपत्ति, i. e. सम्-पद् + ति, f. Prosperity, Hit. i. d. 141, M.M.; success, Lass. 3, 20; power.
 --Comp.
संपाति संपाति, i. e. सम्-पत् + इ, m. A fabulous bird, Mahāvīrac. 74, 1.

संपद् संपद्, i. e. सम्-पद्, f.
 1. Success, Hit. i. d. 183, M.M.; prosperity, Hit. i. d. 32, M.M.
 2. Blessing, Śāk. d. 189.
 3. Wealth, Śāk. 91, 13; [] power, Megh. 54.
 4. Accomplishment, Mālat. 104, 17; perfection, excellence, Hit. iii. d. 53; Śiś. 9, 1 (अभि-ताप-, Most violent heat, excess of heat).
 5. Advancement in good qualities, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 7.
 6. Adornment, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 18.
 7. Fate, Bhag. 16, 3; 4.
 8. A necklace of pearls.
 9. A treasure, Man. 3, 255; Rājat. 5, 231.

संपराय संपराय, i. e. सम्-परा-इ + अ, m.
 1. War, battle, Daśak. in Chr. 201, 2.
 2. Calamity.
 3. Futurity.
 4. A son.
संपरिशोषण संपरिशोषण, i. e. सम्-परि-शुष् + अन, n. Emaciation, Rām. 2, 10, 30.

संपर्क संपर्क, i. e. सम्-पृच् + अ, m.
 1. Mixture.
 2. Copulation.
 3. Union, Vikr. d. 13; Pañc. iii. d. 58.
 4. Contact, Megh. 26.

संपर्किन् संपर्किन्, i. e. संपर्क + इन्, adj., f. इणी,
 1. Blended, mixed.
 2. United with.
 3. In contact with.
संपर्कीय संपर्कीय, i. e. संपर्क + ईय, adj. Liable to come in contact.

संपाक संपाक, i. e. सम्-पच् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Reasoning, a reasoner.
 2. Impudent.
 3. Lecherous, libertine.
 4. Small, little.
 II. m. A tree, Cassia fistula.

संपात संपात, i. e. सम्-पत् + अ, m.
 1. Concurrence, falling against each other, Johns. Sel. 58, 170; butting together, Pañc. 35, 7.
 2. Meeting, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 15.
 3. Descending, falling down, Bhartṛ. 2, 29; Vikr. 85, 20 (flashing); Daśak. in Chr. 186, 15 (flashing).
 4. Alighting (as a bird), flying (of arrows), Bhag. 1, 20.
 5. A special mode of flight (of birds), Pañc. ii. d. 57.
 6. Going, moving, Utt. Rāmac. 22, 8. []
 7. Being removed, Man. 6, 56.
 8. The son of Garuda, a fabulous bird.
 --Comp.
संपातिन् संपातिन्, i. e. सम्-पत् + इन्, adj., f. नी, Falling together, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 11.

संपादन संपादन, i. e. सम्-पद्, Caus. + अन, n.
 1. Accomplishing, Vikr. 37, 7 (व्रत-, The completion of a vow); effecting, making, Pañc. 133, 1.
 2. Cleansing, Man. 3, 255.
 3. Attaining.
 4. Acquiring.

संपीड संपीड, i. e. सम्-पीड् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Pain, torture.
 2. Agitating, Kir. 7, 12.
 3. Sending.
 II. f. डा, Torment, Man. 12, 76.

संपीडन संपीडन, i. e. सम्-पीड् + अन, n.
 1. Pressing.
 2. Castigation, punishment.
 3. Sending.
संपीति संपीति, i. e. सम्-पा + ति, f. Drinking in company.

संपुट संपुट (cf. पुट), m.
 1. Cavity, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 2; Ṛt. 1, 21.
 2. A covered box.
 3. A flower, commonly Kuruvaka.

संपुटक संपुट + क,
 I. m. A casket.
 II. f. टिका, A box filled with ornaments, Pañc. ii. d. 177.
संपूजन संपूजन, i. e. सम्-पूज् + अन, n. Treating with respect, reverence, Man. 3, 137.
संप्रक्षालन संप्रक्षालन, i. e. सम्-प्र-क्षल्, Caus., + अन, n. Inundation, Matsyop. 28.

संप्रणेतृ संप्रणेतृ, i. e. सम्-प्र-नी + तृ, [] m.
 1. A judge, Man. 7, 26.
 2. A ruler.

संप्रतापन संप्रतापन, i. e. सम्-प्र-तप्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Heating, burning.
 2. Afflicting.
 3. One of the hells, Man. 4, 89.
संप्रति संप्रति, i. e. सम्-प्रति, adv. Now, at this time, Pañc. 172, 9; Vikr. d. 15.

संप्रतिपत्ति संप्रतिपत्ति, i. e. सम्-प्रति-पद् + ति, f.
 1. Agreement.
 2. Admission.
 3. Co-operation.
 4. Presence, company.
 5. Assault.
 6. Doing, performing.
संप्रतिरोधक संप्रतिरोधक, i. e. सम्-प्रति-रुध् + अक, n. Durance, actual confinement.
संप्रतीति संप्रतीति, i. e. सम्-प्रति-इ + ति, f. Fame, notoriety, Kir. 3, 43.
संप्रदातृ संप्रदातृ, i. e. सम्-प्र-दा + तृ, m. A giver, Man. 9, 186.

संप्रदान संप्रदान, i. e. सम्-प्र-दा + अन, n.
 1. Giving, gift, Hit. iv. d. 108.
 2. Bestowing in marriage, Man. 7, 152.

संप्रदाय संप्रदाय, i. e. सम्-प्र-दा + अ, m.
 1. Traditional doctrine, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 12 (दत्त-दिव्य-अस्त्र-, adj. Possessed of the traditional knowledge of the celestial arms); Rājat. 5, 139.
 2. A peculiar doctrine and exclusive worship of one divinity.
संप्रधारणा संप्रधारणा, i. e. सम्-प्र-धृ, Caus., + अन, f. Deliberation, determining the propriety or impropriety of anything.
संप्रमोष संप्रमोष, i. e. सम्-प्र-मुष् + अ, m. Suppression, Bhāg. P. 6, 4, 26.

संप्रयोग संप्रयोग, i. e. सम्-प्र-युज् + अ, [] m.
 1. Union, Mālat. 36, 8; copulation, connexion.
 2. Mutual relation, proportion.
 3. Order, natural series.
 4. Magic.

संप्रयोगिन् संप्रयोगिन्, i. e. संप्रयोग + इन्, m.
 1. A joiner.
 2. A libertine.
 3. A catamite.
 4. A conjuror.
संप्रवेश संप्रवेश, i. e. सम्-प्र-विश् + अ, m. Entrance, Rājat. 5, 235.
संप्रश्न संप्रश्न, i. e. सम्-प्रछ् + न, m. Asking, question, Hit. ii. d. 56.

संप्रसाद संप्रसाद, i. e. सम्-प्र-सद् + अ, m.
 1. Favour, grace, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 5.
 2. Serenity, Windischmann, Sankara, 171.

संप्रहार संप्रहार, i. e. सम्-प्र-हृ + अ, m.
 1. Striking, wounding.
 2. War, battle, Śāk. 98, 14.
 3. Going, motion.
 --Comp.

संप्राप्ति संप्राप्ति, i. e. सम्-प्र-आप् + ति, f.
 1. Obtaining, Pañc. 5, 10; acquisition, ib. 104, 1.
 2. Gaining, Man. 7, 208.

संप्रीति संप्रीति, i. e. सम्-प्री + ति,
 1. Attachment, affection, Man. 3, 113.
 2. Friendly assent, 8, 146.
 3. Delight.
संप्रेषण संप्रेषण, i. e. सम्-प्र -1. इष् + अन, n. Sending, Man. 7, 153.

संप्लव संप्लव, i. e. सम्-प्लु + अ, m.
 1. Surge, Rām. 1, 32, 17.
 2. Submerging, submersion, Hariv. 12375; inundation.
 3. Falling on all sides, Man. 4, 103; ruin, Hit. i. d. 72, M.M. (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 458).
संफाल संफाल, i. e. सम्-स्फल् + अ, m. A ram.

संबन्ध संबन्ध, i. e. सम्-बन्ध् + अ,
 1. Connexion, union, Man. 3, 157; Utt. Rāmac. 27, 15 (मद्-, with me); Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 9 (of intimately united subjects, cf. 204, 1; 212, 19; 21).
 2. Relationship, Pañc. ii. d. 106; relation, Hit. i. d. 157, M.M. (अस्येदम् इति सम्बन्धो हानौ दुःखेन गम्यते, The proprietary connection between them is ascertained only by his grief in losing it).

 4. Success, prosperity.
 --Comp.

संबन्धक संबन्ध + क,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating, concerning.
 2. Fit, suitable, Chr. 55, 7.
 3. m. (viz. संधि), Proceeding from relationship, name of a kind of alliance, Hit. iv. d. 123.
 II. m. A friend, Rām. 1, 12, 21.

संबन्धिन् संबन्धिन्, i. e. संबन्ध + इन्, adj. and sbst., f. नी,
 1. Connected with, Pañc. iii. d. 141; inherent, Vedāntas. in Chr. 214, 2; referring to, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 22.
 2. Related, Man. 2, 132; 4, 179; a relation by marriage, Utt. Rāmac. 12, 4; 98, 3.
 3. Belonging to, Pañc. 121, 25.
 4. Possessing good qualities.

संबाध संबाध, i. e. सम्-बाध् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Being thronged, Hariv. 2677.

 4. The road to Tartarus.

 1. Narrow.

 3. Blocked up, Pañc. i. d. 427 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1446); impassable.
 --Comp.

संबाधन संबाधन, i. e. सम्-बाध् + अन, n.
 1. Obstructing, Pañc. i. d. 427 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1446).
 2. A barrier, a gate.
 3. A door-keeper.
 4. The point of a stake or spit.

संबुद्धि संबुद्धि, i. e. सम्-बुध् + ति, f.
 1. Calling, or calling to.
 2. (In grammar), The vocative case, Pāṇ. 2, 3, 49.
संबोध संबोध, i. e. सम्-बुध् + अ, m. Instructing, informing.

संबोधन संबोधन, i. e. सम्-बुध् + अन,
 1. Calling.
 2. Addressing, Chr. 38, 16.
 3. (In grammar), The vocative case (see संबुद्धि).

 1. Mixing, union.

 3. Adequacy, ability.

 5. Compatibility, consistency.
 6. Agreement.
 7. Acquaintance.

 9. Springing up, Hit. iv. d. 72; origin, Man. 1, 116; birth, Mālat. 156, 6; Pañc. 263, 23; production, Hit. 16, 5, M.M.
 10. Producing and rearing, Man. 2, 227.
 11. Cause, motive, Pañc. i. d. 328 (ग्रहण-, of taking, viz. the life of a dependent).
 --Comp.

संभार संभार, i. e. सम्-भृ + अ, m.
 1. Maintaining, supporting.
 2. Apparatus, things required for any act or affair, Rām. 1, 11, 13; Pañc. 157, 22.
 3. Provision, getting everything ready.
 4. Completion, Mālat. 171, 5.
 5. Fullness, wealth, Nal. 26, 24.
 6. Multitude, heap, quantity, Utt. Rāmac. 141, 8; Pañc. i. d. 35; Rājat. 5, 273.

संभावन संभावन, i. e. सम्-भू, Caus., + अन, n., and f. ना,
 1. Adequacy, ability.
 2. Fitness.
 3. Possibility.
 4. Doubt.
 5. Considering, Ragh. 5, 28 (f.); reflecting.
 6. Review, Pañc. 218, 6 (f.).
 7. Thought, Mālav. 38, 15 (Prākṛ.).
 8. Worship, Pañc. 264, 4; honour, Rājat. 5, 328.
 9. Love, Śāk. d. 163 (f.).
 --Comp.

संभाष संभाष, i. e. सम्-भाष् + अ,
 I. m. Conversation, Man. 2, 195; in स्नेह-, Kind conversation, Pañc. 51, 23.
 II. f.
 1. Greeting, Hit. i. d. 38, M.M.
 2. A criminal connexion, Man. 8, 363.
 3. Contract, agreement.
 4. War-cry, watch-word.
 --Comp.

संभाषण संभाषण, i. e. सम्-भाष् + अन, n.
 1. Conversation, Lass. 41, 17.
 2. Sexual intercourse, Lass. 10, 20.
 3. War-cry, watchword.

संभूति संभूति, i. e. सम्-भू + ति, f.
 1. Combination.
 2. Birth, Man. 2, 147.
 3. Origin, Rājat. 5, 73; production.
 --Comp.

संभृति संभृति, i. e. सम्-भृ + ति, f.
 1. Support, nourishment.
 2. Preparation, provision.
 3. Plenitude, fullness.

संभेद संभेद, i. e. सम्-भिद् + अ, m.
 1. Breaking, splitting.
 2. Union, mixture, Mālat. 167, 4.
 3. The confluence of two rivers, Man. 8, 356, or the junction of a river with the sea.

संभोग संभोग, i. e. सम्-भुज् + अ, m.
 1. Enjoyment, Pañc. ii. d. 67; sensual enjoyment, Rājat. 5, 230.
 2. Coition, Megh. 94; copulation.
 3. A catamite.
 4. Use, occupation, Man. 8, 200.
 --Comp.

संभोजन संभोजन, i. e. सम्-भुज् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Convivial, Man. 8, 141.
 II. n. A meal.

संभ्रम संभ्रम, i. e. सम्-भ्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Turning round, revolving.
 2. Haste, MBh. 1, 764.
 3. Confusion [] arising from fear, joy, haste, etc.; cheerful quickness, Bhartṛ. 2, 54; zeal, Rājat. 5, 306.
 4. Fear, alarm, Man. 4, 118; Pañc. 52, 16.
 5. Error, ignorance.
 6. Reverence, Hit. iv. d. 103 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3337).
 --Comp.
संभ्रमभृत् संभ्रम-भृ + त्, adj. Embarrassed, Śiś. 9, 71.

संमति संमति, i. e. सम्-मन् + ति, f.
 1. Agreement.
 2. Approbation, Pañc. 229, 1.
 3. Regard, respect, Kir. 10, 36.
 4. Real knowledge.
 5. Wish, desire.
संमद संमद, i. e. सम्-मद् + अ, m. Joy, Mālat. 77, 11; happiness, Govardh. Āryā Saptaśatī, 275, d.
संमाद संमाद, i. e. सम्-मद् + अ, m. Intoxication, frenzy.

संमर्द संमर्द, i. e. सम्-मृद् + अ, m.
 1. Friction, rubbing.
 2. War, battle, Kathās. 3, 66.
 3. Trampling on, treading on, Rājat. 5, 57.
संमार्जक संमार्जक, i. e. सम्-मृज् + अक, m. A sweeper.

संमार्जन संमार्जन, i. e. सम्-मृज् + अन,
 I. n. Cleaning, purifying, sweeping, Pañc. 27, 5; 26, 22.
 II. f. नी, A broom.
संमिश्र संमिश्र, i. e. सम्-मिश्र, adj. Mixed, blended, joined.
संमिश्ल संमिश्ल (= the last, with ल् for र्), adj. Endowed, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.
संमुखीन संमुखीन, i. e. सम्-मुख + ईन, adj. Before, in front of.

संमूर्छन संमूर्छन, i. e. सम्-मुर्छ् + अन, n.
 1. Uniform, or universal expansion, or permeation.
 2. Increasing.
 3. Height.
 4. Fainting, insensibility.
संमेलन संमेलन, i. e. सम्-मिल् + अन, n. Union, Utt. Rāmac. 177, 9.
संमोद संमोद, i. e. सम्-मुद् + अ, m. Pleasure, delight.

संमोह संमोह, i. e. सम्-मुह् + अ, m.
 1. Beguilement, fascination.
 2. Stupefaction, Utt. Rāmac. 107, 8.
 3. Folly.
 4. Illusion of mind, Man. 7, 12.
 5. Ignorance.
 6. Fainting.
सांयात्रिक सांयात्रिक, i. e. संयात्रा + इक, m. A merchant who trades by sea, Pañc. i. d. 220.

सांयुगीन सांयुगीन, i. e. संयुग + ईन,
 I. adj. Skilled in war, Vikr. 87, 2; warlike, Ragh. 11, 30.
 II. m.
 1. A soldier skilled in war.
 2. An able leader.
सांराविण सांराविण, i. e. सम्-रु + इन् + अ, n. Shout, Mālat. 77, 12.

सांवत्सरिक सांवत्सरिक, i. e. संवत्सर + इक,
 I. adj. Yearly, Man. 7, 80.
 II. m. An astrologer, Pañc. 156, 21.
सांवादिक सांवादिक, i. e. संवाद + इक, m. A logician.
सांवृत्तिक सांवृत्तिक, संवृत्ति + इक, Phenomenal, illusory.

सांशयिक सांशयिक, i. e. संशय + इक, adj.
 1. Dubious, Pañc. iii. d. 11.
 2. Irresolute.
सांसारिक सांसारिक, i. e. संसार + इक, adj. Worldly, Utt. Rāmac. 45, 12.

सांसिद्धिक सांसिद्धिक, i. e. संसिद्धि + इक, adj.
 1. Belonging to a thing's nature, innate, Bhāṣāp. 38.
 2. Effected naturally, spontaneous, Sāṅkhya Aph. iii. 20.
 3. Effected by supernatural means, as spells, etc. ib. v. 111.
सांस्थानिक सांस्थानिक, i. e. संस्थान + इक, m. An inhabitant or native of the same place.
सानसि सानसि, m. (?), f. (?), Gold.

सानु सानु, probably सो + नु, m. and n.
 1. End, point, the top of a mountain, Mālat. 145, 10.
 2. Level ground on the top or edge of a mountain, tableland, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 13.
 3. A forest.
 4. A shoot, a sprout.
 5. A road.
 6. A gale of wind.
 7. A learned man, a sage.
 8. The sun.
 --Comp.

सानुमन्त् सानु + मन्त्,
 I. m. A mountain, Vikr. d. 76.
 II. f. मती, The name of an Apsaras, Śāk. 77, 1.

सान्त्वन सान्त्व् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Conciliation, reconcilement.
 2. Appeasing, Rājat. 5, 345 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 II. n., and f. ना.
 1. Speaking kindly and in a conciliatory manner.
 2. Mildness, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 21 (n.); [] kind or deceiving words, Pañc. iv. d. 1 (n. pl.).
 3. Friendly salutation and enquiry.
सान्दृष्टिक सान्दृष्टिक, i. e. सम्-दृश् + ति + इक, m. Immediate consequence.

सान्द्र सान्द्र,
 I. adj.
 1. Thick, coarse, gross, Caurap. 12; Ṛt. 1, 20; intense, Śiś. 9, 15; 22.
 2. Stout, robust.
 3. Much, abundant, Mālat. 60, 13.
 4. Vehement, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830; Daśak. in Chr. 190, 8; Ragh. 7, 11; सान्द्रतर, Increased, Śiś. 9, 37.
 5. Clustering, collected.
 6. Compact, but having interstices.
 7. Unctuous, oily, Kāvya Prak. 62, 11.
 8. Soft, bland.
 9. Pleasing, agreeable, Mālat. 127, 12; Megh. 97 (v. r.).
 II. n.
 1. A thicket, a wood.
 2. A heap, a cluster.
 --Cf. probably ἁδρός.
सान्धिविग्रहिक सान्धिविग्रहिक, i. e. संधि-विग्रह + इक, m. Prime minister (who decides peace and war), Lass. 2. ed. 16, 9; Sāh. D. 7, 8.

सान्नहनिक सान्नहनिक, i. e. संनहन + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Bearing or putting on armour.
 2. Calling to arms.
 II. m. An armour-bearer.

सान्निध्य सान्निध्य, i. e. संनिधि + य, n.
 1. Vicinity, Pañc. 258, 7.
 2. Presence, Man. 8, 87; attendance, Hit. 53, 12.
 3. ˚यम्, adv. Near, Indr. 5, 24.
 --Comp.
सान्निध्यतस् सान्निध्य + तस्, adv. From the proximity, Mālat. 48, 8.

सान्निपातिक सान्निपातिक, i. e. संनिपात + इक, adj.
 1. Complicated (as disease), relating to the morbid state of the three humours collectively, Hit. iii. d. 119.
 2. Miscellaneous, promiscuous, collective.
संकल्प- + सिद्ध संकल्प- + सिद्ध, adj. endowed with supernatural powers by energy, Chr. 58, 4.
संहत- + स्तन संहत- + स्तन (vb. हन्), adj., f. नी, whose breasts are very contiguous to each other, Rām. 3, 52, 35.
संकेत- + स्थान संकेत- + स्थान, n. 1. place of assignation. 2. a sign, an intimation. Lass. 7, 5.
सन्न- + हर्ष सन्न- + हर्ष (vb. सद्), adj. destitute of joy.
